subject: [PATCH v3 06/14] SUNRPC: report local rpcbind calls that get no answer

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new error code, -ENAVAIL, to indicate that an rpcbind call received no answer. It also adds a counter, sv_rpcb_failures, to track the number of unanswered calls. The caller can use this count to determine if there have been any errors. This change is intended to improve the handling of rpcbind failures and provide more information to callers about the status of their requests.
